title: Replace a Tool Pocket on Your Haas Side Mount Tool Changer (SMTC)

steps.title: Bring the damaged pocket into position and press E-stop
Remove the top fasteners and the cam-box sheet metal
Remove tools and mark the carousel disk and pocket
Remove number ring, disconnect main air, and remove pilot check valve
Remove pocket stop, shoulder bolt, retaining bolt, and pocket
Grease pocket slider, install new pocket, and fasten
Verify pocket movement and switch readings
Install pocket stop, check valve, and number disc

claims.text: The procedure replaces a damaged pocket on the side mount tool changer.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states the task at the start of the video.

claims.text: Set the rapids down to 25% and rotate to the damaged pocket.
Press e stop.
Press e stop once the pocket is in position.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter specifies the condition for pressing e stop.

claims.text: Remove four fasteners on top of the machine.
Remove three pieces of sheet metal from the bottom of the cam box: one larger piece and two smaller pieces right below the double arm.
The sheet metal pieces are removed in order to gain access to the damaged pocket and the switches behind it.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states the reason for removing the sheet metal.

claims.text: The four fasteners on top of the machine must be removed before the larger panel can be moved.
Remove all tools from the carousel.
Put a mark on the disk and on the pocket.
Tools are removed because the repair area will be worked on for a few minutes.
The disk and pocket are marked to ensure the carousel disk is installed correctly during reinstallation.
Remove the number ring.
Disconnect the main air to the machine.
Remove the pilot check valve.
Removing the check valve allows the pocket to be moved up and down freely to get to a screw.
Remove the four bolts from the pocket stop.
Remove the shoulder bolt on the backside of the carousel right next to the lower proximity switch.
Remove the retaining bolt and remove the pocket.
The bolts from the pocket stop are removed to continue with the removal of the pocket.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states the reason for removing the bolts.

claims.text: The pocket stop must be removed before the shoulder bolt can be removed.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states 'now with this pocket stop remove we'll remove the shoulder bolt'.

claims.text: The shoulder bolts must be removed before removing the retaining bolt and pocket.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states 'with the shoulder bolts remove will then remove the retaining bolt'.

claims.text: Rotate the cam follower to check that it is spinning freely.
Check the plunger inside the pocket.
The plunger is checked to make sure it is not worn out.
These checks must be done before installing the new pocket.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states 'before we install the new pocket there's a few things we need to check'.

claims.text: Apply grease in the pocket slider.
Install the pocket to the slider and install both back in position.
Reinstall the retainer bolt and tighten it.
Lower the pocket and attach the shoulder bolt and screw it in.
The pocket is moving freely.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states this outcome after installing.

claims.text: The presenter is reading the pocket up and pocket down switches.
Install the pocket stop.
Install the check valve.
Reinstall the number disc by lining up the dot on the number disc with the dot on the pocket.
The check valve is installed after the pocket stop and new pocket are installed.
Install the remaining three panels.
Install the tools.
Tools are installed after the panels are all in place.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states 'now with the panels all in place we'll install the tools'.

claims.text: Test the system.
Release the e-stop and run the tool changer.
Run the tool changer through several tool changes.
The tool changer is run through several tool changes to ensure everything is working correctly.
Testing occurs with the new pocket installed, the panels secured, and the main air turned on.

evidence_links.explanation: The presenter states these conditions for testing.
